title: Greek roots I
lede: Greek roots run science, medicine and technology. Learn these and technical words stop being scary.

sections.md:
## Fifteen Greek roots
| Root | Meaning | Words |
|---|---|---|
| bio | life | biology, biography, antibiotic |
| graph, gram | write, draw | autograph, telegram, graphic |
| logy, log | study of, word | geology, psychology, dialogue |
| phon | sound | telephone, symphony, phonics |
| photo | light | photograph, photosynthesis |
| tele | far | telescope, television, telecom |
| auto | self | automatic, autonomy, autopilot |
| micro | small | microscope, microchip |
| macro | large | macroeconomics |
| chron | time | chronic, chronological, synchronize |
| geo | earth | geography, geology, geometry |
| hydro | water | hydrate, hydraulic, hydroelectric |
| psych | mind | psychology, psychic |
| therm | heat | thermometer, thermal |
| meter | measure | odometer, perimeter, speedometer |

sections.title: Decoding a business word
steps: economics = how money and resources move.
sections.answer: **Big-picture economics**: whole countries and markets, as opposed to microeconomics, which looks at single businesses.

sections.label: Greek vs Latin
sections.md: Latin roots dominate everyday and legal English. Greek roots dominate science, medicine and tech. Many sciences pair them: "tele-vision" is Greek tele + Latin vis.
